result:
Done — `bun run typecheck` passes and `bun test` is 6/6 green (3 files), with `bunx guren check` reporting 0 failures.

**What I built**

New account registration now hands the welcome email to the queue and returns as before. `app/Http/Controllers/Auth/RegisterController.ts` dispatches `SendWelcomeEmailJob` (`app/Jobs/SendWelcomeEmailJob.ts`) with the name and address after the user is created and signed in — after both refusal paths (validation 422, email already taken), so a rejected sign-up queues and sends nothing. The job resolves the mail manager and sends `WelcomeMail` (`app/Mail/WelcomeMail.ts`), whose subject is `Welcome to <APP_NAME>, <name>!` (app name from a new `appName()` helper in `config/app.ts`) with a plain-text and HTML greeting addressing the user by name; the sender comes from the mail manager's configured `MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS`/`MAIL_FROM_NAME`.

Neither subsystem existed, so both are now wired the way this project structures configuration: `config/queue.ts` maps `QUEUE_CONNECTION` to a driver (`sync`/`memory`/`redis`) and `config/mail.ts` maps `MAIL_MAILER` to a transport (`log`/`memory`/`resend`), both read lazily at boot the way `config/database.ts` resolves its filename. `app/Providers/QueueProvider.ts` binds the queue manager, activates the default driver globally (what `Job.dispatch()` and `guren queue:work` use) and registers the app's job classes so a worker can resolve them by name; `app/Providers/MailProvider.ts` binds the mail manager and publishes it globally, which is where jobs — running outside any request container — look it up. Both are registered in `src/app.ts`. No dispatcher names a driver or transport, so `sync`/`log` → `redis`/`resend` is purely an environment change; I verified the `.env` defaults end to end (sync queue + log mailer prints the To/From/Subject/body and registration still 303s to `/dashboard`). `tests/RegisterController.test.ts` covers queue-not-sent, the message produced when the queued work runs, and both refusal paths, and `docs/adr/0002-send-the-welcome-email-from-the-queue.md` records the decision.
